external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Woods Bagot is a global design and architecture firm with a team of over 1,000 experts working across 17 studios in Australia, Asia, Middle East, Europe and North America.
With studios in Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney, Shanghai studios, the versatile ASPECT team work across local, regional and international markets.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: 32 Shepherd Street, Liverpool | Next generation waterfront living. Experiential landscaping, fully integrated into the design, allows residents to live among various natural environments, including a spectacular 1,200sqm rooftop garden and pool.

28 & 30 Shepherd Street, Liverpool | Functionality and flow in internal planning, keep balconies large and make smart use of space inside and out. Contemporary but warm finishes, with timber flooring and joinery complemented with metal accents.

26 Shepherd Street, Liverpool | A masterpiece of design offering 82 architecturally crafted, spacious, light-filled apartments and townhouses. Architects, Woods Bagot brought a whole new level of premium living, with a private rooftop deck and pool.

6A & 6B Atkinson Street, Liverpool | With an abundance of natural light and clever use of storage, these homes are functional yet stylish. Residents enjoy first-class amenities including a communal rooftop BBQ area and a swimming pool.
